nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Polynomial regression with adaptive degree selection (up to degree 2 was selected for the final models, though up to 20 was allowed).
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: ScanOMetrics fits a low order polynomial age model to each metric separately... Starting at zero, the polynomial degree is gradually increased... The maximum degree was set to 20... Normative models... had degree d = 0... d = 1... d = 2... No higher degree was selected.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.location: study_1/1-s2.0-S2213158224000639-mmc1.docx.md: Creating normative models / Step c; study_1/Romascano2024.pdf.md: Section 3.9

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Cortical thickness (mean and SD), cortical GMV, subcortical volumes, midline structures (ventricles), brain lobes, hemispheres, and ICV. Also asymmetry indices.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: regional cortical GMV as well as regional mean and standard deviation of the CTh... subcortical volumes: 8 structures... 3 volumes of midline structures (brain stem, 3rd and 4th ventricles)... whole brain: estimate for intracranial volume (ICV)... asymmetry indices
